title: feat(console): Studio landing cards open package management, and link to all packages
body:
Fixes #35196
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：管理员从首页进 Studio 后，每张应用卡片上多了「管理」按钮，一点就能停用或重新启用一个模块，页面右上角还多了「全部软件包」链接；以前要先打开应用、再点顶栏应用名、再点弹层最底下一项才找得到。
- 为什么做：HotCRM 的开发想关掉一个随代码加载的模块却找不到停用按钮，只能手输网址；这次把入口挂到 Studio 首页上。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是 Studio 首页的卡片按钮打不开管理面板或排版走样，停用和启用本身走的是原来那张面板，撤回本改动即可恢复原样。
- 要你做什么：无，席位落地。

## 席位核对

### What changes

- **Studio landing (`BuilderLanding.tsx`)**: every package card (installed apps and the author's own) carries **Manage**, which opens the same `PackageDetailSheet` the top-bar switcher's "Package info & settings" opens. The sheet's Disable follows the served `disableable`; Enable shows on any disabled package. After a lifecycle action the landing re-reads the list and the sheet's record (a failed re-read closes the sheet with a toast, the switcher's posture). The title row gains **All packages**, a link to the unfiltered Packages route (`/apps/setup/component/developer/packages`, no `source` query).
- **Card layout**: each card's two buttons stack in one column, so the app name keeps the width it had with one button. Measured first with them side by side: at 1400px the names truncated ("Multi-Pack..."); stacked, `scrollWidth > clientWidth` is false for both names at 1400px and at 390px, and no horizontal page scroll.
- **`PackageSwitcher.tsx`**: the switcher's full-row read is hoisted, unchanged in body, from an in-component `useCallback` to the exported `fetchInstalledPackageRow`, so both doors open the sheet on the same record. The switcher keeps its own `fetchFullPackage` alias, so its tests and comments still read the same.
- **`setup-nav.contributions.ts` comment and `setup-packages-door.test.ts`**: they now name the door a default boot serves (the console Studio at `/_console/studio`: landing link plus card Manage) instead of `studio.app.ts`'s Overview → Packages, which only a host that loads `@objectstack/studio` serves. The pin's third case is retitled as the declared app's entry; its assertions are unchanged.
- i18n: four `studio` namespace rows, en and zh. Changeset: `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n`, patch.
- Not touched: the `@objectstack/studio` load lists, Setup navigation entries, `packages/spec/**` (ruling 甲, option C).

### Tests

<details><summary>New test, landing tests, switcher tests (head 9428e59ab)</summary>

- `BuilderLanding.packagesDoor-35196.test.tsx` (5 cases, real `BuilderLanding` and real `PackageDetailSheet`): a `disableable` code module's Manage opens a sheet with Disable; control, a read-only app the door refuses opens one with neither Disable nor Enable; a disabled module's sheet offers Enable; every card carries Manage; the All packages link is the unfiltered route.
- `vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/BuilderLanding` at 9428e59ab: Test Files 13 passed (13), Tests 95 passed (95).
- Earlier, at 78f732a96: `BuilderLanding*` + `StudioDesignSurface.manage*` / `.package*` / `.homeLoop*` + `packages-io*`: Test Files 25 passed (25), Tests 222 passed (222).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` at 9428e59ab: exit 0. `@object-ui/i18n type-check` at 78f732a96: exit 0 (i18n unchanged since).
- `@objectstack/platform-objects` `setup-packages-door.test.ts`: Tests 3 passed (3).

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation, one run, then restored</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` changed `const manageButton = (p: PkgEntry) => (` to `... => null && (` (anchor 1 → 0, blob 30ad6272 → cadcb7d1). Result: 4 of 5 cases red (every Manage case); the All packages link case stayed green, as expected. Restored: the blob equals HEAD (30ad6272) and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The test imports `./BuilderLanding` from source, so no build was needed.

</details>

### Acceptance notes

- Browser readings before the change (B1–B3) are on the card, comment 7008882599. Summary: the switcher entry works end to end (`PATCH …/disable` 200, `…/enable` 200); a disabled package is not stranded; the landing had no Manage and no link to the full list.
- The switcher's entry is labelled "Package info & settings", not "Manage". It is left as it is (outside this card's surface); the landing's button is the visible "Manage".
- A disabled package's landing card shows no disabled state; the sheet does. Not changed here.
- The All packages route is hosted under the Setup app's address, the one console app every boot loads; no Setup nav item is added (ruling 甲). A Studio-hosted route for the full list does not exist today.

### Verification

<details><summary>Browser, after the change</summary>

Boot: `examples/app-multi-package`, `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin` on a private port. The Console was served from `ui/` source through Vite HMR, proxied to that backend; Playwright Chromium, admin user.
- Landing at 1400px: two installed-app cards, each with Customize and Manage; All packages in the title row with href `/apps/setup/component/developer/packages`.
- Manage on `com.example.multi.orders` opened the sheet (module · Read-only · code · Enabled · View info / Disable / Export). Disable → confirm → `PATCH …/disable` 200 → Enable shown → `PATCH …/enable` 200 → Disable shown.
- The unfiltered route on the built Console (`/_console/apps/setup/component/developer/packages`, which redirects to the setup package-id segment) lists both packages under a Packages heading.

</details>

<details><summary>Gates (local subset, final head 9428e59ab)</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran` (with exit codes): 69 derived families accounted for: 68 run with exit 0, 1 NOT MEASURED.
- NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET (it needs every package's `dist/`; only the CLI closure was built here). CI runs it.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: Test Files 171 passed | 2 skipped (173), exit 0. The first run was SIGKILLed when the shared box ran out of memory; it was run again under the lock.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs --branch=HEAD`: VERDICT clean exit 0.
- Families CI runs (lint, Test Core, Type Check UI and the rest) are left to the PR's check-runs.

</details>
